stem: 根据埃格蒙特集团原则，金融情报机构（FIU）之间的信息交换应遵循以下原则：

options.A: 不要求在信息使用方式上获得对等安排
options.B: 仅当外国金融情报机构的地位与执法相关时
options.C: 自由地、自发地，并应请求，在互惠的基础上
options.D: 对所提供的财务和行政信息数量设定限制

stem_en: Under the Egmont Group Principles, information exchange among financial intelligence units (FIUs) should be conducted:

options_en.A: Without the expectation of reciprocity on how the information will be used
options_en.B: Only if the status of the foreign FIU is related to law enforcement
options_en.C: Freely, spontaneously, and upon request, on the basis of reciprocity
options_en.D: With set limits on the amount of financial and administrative information provided
